<thought>We have no existing data, so we will retrieve polymorph data for 40 sulfide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the specified filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3). The data will be saved in a subdirectory “polymorph_data” within the current workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>

    "compositions": [

        "CdS", "CdS2", "Ag2S", "AgS", "Bi2S3", "Sb2S3", "GeS", "GeS2", "SiS2", "SiS",
        "CrS", "CrS2", "V2S3", "ZrS2", "HfS2", "NbS2", "TaS2", "PdS", "PtS"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_sulphides_trial_10/polymorph_data"
